model_scope: Independent homogeneous nearest-neighbour Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d; each undirected nearest-neighbour edge is open with probability p independently.
exact_target: For every integer d with 3<=d<=10, let theta_d(p)=P_p(|C(0)|=infinity) and p_c(d)=inf{p in [0,1]:theta_d(p)>0}. Show theta_d(p_c(d))=0. Equivalently, P_(p_c)(there exists any infinite open cluster)=0, by translation invariance and countability.
